Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Friday said there should be a comprehensive review of the country’s solid waste management framework, including Republic Act 9003 and its amendments, following the ongoing fire at the Navotas Sanitary Landfill.

The senator renewed her call as she lamented that the fire had affected nearby communities, from residents in the CAMANAVA area, as well as other parts of the National Capital Region.
